name: Diagnostic Usage & Time-Window Monitor
description: Samples per-process CPU and memory while AegisWin is unlocked, records spikes inside a daily watch window, correlates them with application crash and hang events, and tracks which app was in the foreground.

subComponents.name: Per-Process CPU & Memory Spikes
subComponents.description: Records processes that cross the CPU or memory threshold during the watch window (sampled every 5 seconds).

subComponents.name: Application Crash & Hang Correlator
subComponents.description: Links Application Error (1000) and Application Hang (1002) events to spikes of the same process in the preceding 10 minutes.

subComponents.name: Foreground App Tracker
subComponents.description: Records which process owned the foreground window each time it changes. Process names only, never window titles.

tools.name: Configure Diagnostic Watch Window
tools.description: Sets the daily time window (24-hour HH:MM; equal start and end means all day), the CPU and memory thresholds, and optionally which process names to watch. Only changes this monitor's own settings, not Windows.

tools.name: Capture Correlated Diagnostic Clues
tools.description: Returns current system load, top processes by CPU and memory, recorded spikes, crash and hang events from the last 24 hours with related spikes, and foreground app changes.

tools.name: Synthesize Diagnostic Clues with AI
tools.description: Sends a diagnostic snapshot to the LLM service to identify the most likely culprit.

tools.name: Purge Recorded Telemetry
tools.description: Deletes all recorded spikes and foreground app history from memory. Telemetry is never written to disk.
